blocks.title: Wavefront
blocks.text: Wavefront aik khayali satah hai jo un tamam nuqton ko jorti hai jahan lehron ka phase aik jaisa ho.

items: Plane wavefronts: seedhi lakeeron se dikhaye jate hain, jaise door sitaron ki roshni aur ripple tank mein pani ki lehrein.
Circular wavefronts: dairon se dikhaye jate hain, jaise talab mein pani par bante hain.
Spherical wavefronts: teen-jehti khala mein point source ki awaz ya roshni ki lehar se bante hain.

blocks.text: Khala mein point source ke liye wavefronts spherical hote hain jo har simt phailte hain. Bohat zyada faaslon par, jaise Sooraj ki roshni ke liye, aise wavefront ka chhota hissa satah (plane) samjha ja sakta hai. Lagatar wavefronts ka kam se kam faasla aik wavelength hai, aur lehar ki tawanai hamesha wavefront ke amudan chalti hai. Wavefront ke amudan us ki safar ki simt dikhane wali lakeer ray kehlati hai. Ripple tank mein vibrator jaisa line source plane wavefronts deta; point source do jehton mein circular aur teen mein spherical wavefronts deta hai. Lens ke focal point par rakha roshni ka source lens ki doosri taraf plane wavefronts deta hai. Yeh chapter interference aur diffraction parhne ke liye plane wavefronts use karta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. (a) Saat mutawazi khari lakeerein (plane wavefronts) jinhein aik ufqi teer (ray) amudan kaat-ta hai. (b) Surkh point source ke gird hum-markaz daire, aur aath teer bahar ki taraf. (c) Point source se daen khulta cone; cone mein teen kham-daar tukre jo faasle ke saath bare hote hain, har aik par bahar ki taraf teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: (a, b, c) Plane aur circular lehrein; spherical wavefronts ke hisse. Source se bohat door har hissa plane ban jata hai (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.1 (b) par 'Gas pressure' aur 'Self-gravity' likha hai; yeh labels chapter 13 ki kisi aur figure se ghalti se aa gaye hain aur wavefronts se in ka koi talluq nahi, is liye khaake mein nahi. Har ray (shua) wavefront par amood (perpendicular) hoti hai, aur source se door spherical wavefront ka chhota hissa taqreeban seedha (plane) lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ray aur wavefront ka kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Ray wavefront ke amudan lakeer hai jo dikhati hai ke lehar (us ki tawanai) kis simt chalti hai.

items: Plane, circular aur spherical wavefronts; door spherical plane lagta.
Ray: wavefront ke amudan; wavefronts ka faasla = aik wavelength.
